title: 'Simply Heavenly' and her voice in movies and television
summary: She played in a short-run stage show of Langston Hughes's 'Simply Heavenly', and her voice was used in films such as 'Panic in the Streets', 'My Blue Heaven' and 'The Steel Trap', though she never watched them. She did hear the television 'Come Home Bill Bailey'.
